query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS translation_activity_log (
  id int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  entityType enum('office','template') NOT NULL,
  entityId int NOT NULL,
  entityName varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  translatorId int NOT NULL,
  translatorName varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  actionType enum('created','updated','bulk_import') NOT NULL,
  fieldChanged varchar(50),
  previousValue text,
  newValue text,
  source enum('manual','bulk_import','request_approval') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'manual',
  requestId int,
  createdAt timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY(id),
  INDEX entity_idx (entityType, entityId),
  INDEX translator_idx (translatorId),
  INDEX action_idx (actionType),
  INDEX source_idx (source),
  INDEX date_idx (createdAt)
)
